teaching.description: Selected as a mentor (equivalent to teaching assistant) and grader for each of Calculus II, Linear Algebra, Combinatorics, Number Theory & Cryptography, Statistical Linear Modelling. Provided weekly study hours as well as ad hoc review sessions prior to exams. Received the Bruce Jay Levy Prize upon graduation for my dedication to fostering collaborative learning in the department, largely through my work as a teaching assistant.
